pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.Bf4 O-O 9.Nd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Nd2-f1 with the bishop on f1 and used a3 to stop ...b5; plan 3 pushed f2-f4 with the bishop on f4. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted ...Na6-c7 after ...a6 and called the b8-knight the f6-knight. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted ...Na6-c7 with a pawn on a6. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.h3 O-O 9.Bd3 b5

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.h3 O-O 9.Bd3 b5 10.Nxb5
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Nxe6 (no such capture); plan 2 called White's own d5-pawn an outpost and had a4 neutralise the g7-bishop (reviewer catch). Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.h3 O-O 9.Bd3 b5 10.Nxb5 Nxe4
pages.notes: Plan 2 attacked an e4-pawn already captured; plan 1 relied on a White queenside majority that does not exist (reviewer catch). Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.h3 O-O 9.Bd3 b5 10.Nxb5 Re8 11.O-O Nxe4
pages.notes: Plan 2 pressed an e4-pawn already captured. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.h3 O-O 9.Bd3 Bd7
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 had ...Bc6 pressing e4 (d5 blocks the diagonal); plan 1 pushed f4-f5 with the knight on f3. Rewrote overview sentence and both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.h3 O-O 9.Bd3 Re8 10.O-O c4
pages.notes: Plan 1 prepared a ...e5 break with no Black e-pawn; plan 2 pushed f2-f4-f5 through the f3-knight and used a3. Rewrote both plans around 11.Bxc4 Nxe4.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.Bg5 h6 9.Bh4 a6
pages.notes: Plan 2 called the queenside majority a minority attack; plan 4 played ...Na6-c7 with a pawn on a6. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.
